note: Verified ICAR AICRP-STCR equations from 'Four Decades of STCR Research - Crop Wise Recommendations'. Each equation's coefficients are transcribed from the compendium and checked against its own ready-reckoner table. cf_percent is set to 100 so that nr_per_quintal IS the final 'a' coefficient and cs_percent/cf_percent IS the final 'b' coefficient (the soil-test deduction factor).

profiles.region: U.S. Nagar, Haridwar, Nainital and parts of Western U.P.
profiles.source: ICAR AICRP-STCR Compendium, Uttarakhand Wheat, GBPUAT Pantnagar, variety UP-2382 (with FYM/IPNS form). Rabi, irrigated, Mollisols and Inceptisols.
profiles.verified_by: Jal-Khadd engine: reckoner (40 q/ha, 10 t/ha FYM) P and K exact, N within 0.7 kg (printed b_N=0.67 is rounded).
profiles.caution: Variety UP-2382 is old and equations are variety-specific. Source does not confirm whether soil P/K and doses are P vs P2O5, K vs K2O. Soil-test calibration: alk. KMnO4-N 150-240, Olsen-P 20-60, NH4OAc-K 150-200 kg/ha.

profiles.region: U.S. Nagar, Haridwar, Nainital and parts of Western U.P.
profiles.source: ICAR AICRP-STCR Compendium, Uttarakhand Maize, GBPUAT Pantnagar, variety Pragati (with FYM/IPNS form). Kharif.
profiles.verified_by: Jal-Khadd engine: reckoner (35 q/ha, 10 t/ha FYM) P and K exact, N values match as a set.
profiles.caution: Variety Pragati only. Source reckoner's N column is shifted one row relative to the soil-test column; values themselves match the equation. Soil calibration: N 200-260, P 10-40, K 180-240 kg/ha.

profiles.region: U.S. Nagar, Haridwar, Nainital and parts of Western U.P.
profiles.source: ICAR AICRP-STCR Compendium, Uttarakhand Mustard, GBPUAT Pantnagar, variety PYS-I (with FYM/IPNS form). Rabi.
profiles.verified_by: Jal-Khadd engine: reckoner (15 q/ha, 10 t/ha FYM) N, P, K exact.
profiles.caution: Source prints K soil term as 'SP' (typo for SK). Variety PYS-I only; Kranti equation is garbled and not used. Soil calibration: N 198-325, P 15-35, K 168-320 kg/ha.

profiles.region: Delhi and adjoining UP (Saharanpur, Muzaffarnagar, Meerut); Haryana (Karnal, Panipat). Haridwar NOT named — by adjacency only.
profiles.source: ICAR AICRP-STCR Compendium, IARI New Delhi, HYV without FYM. Typic Haplustept, alluvial. Kharif, irrigated.
profiles.verified_by: Jal-Khadd engine: reckoner (50 and 60 q/ha) reproduced to within its 5-kg rounding.
profiles.caution: Applicability to Haridwar is by adjacency only: confirm with KVK Dhanauri. The source reckoner applies a maintenance minimum (10-15 kg P2O5) where the equation gives ~0; that floor is not modelled. No manure term. Soil calibration: N 100-375, P 10-38, K 100-375 kg/ha.
